name: GPI Studio
description: GPI Studio reads where business work slows down, repeats, or gets protected by the system, then turns that read into maps and bounded next moves.

primary_paths.name: Reads
primary_paths.purpose: Public reads, essays, and company analysis through the GPI lens.

primary_paths.name: Lens
primary_paths.purpose: The GPI states and seven dimensions used to read organizational friction.

primary_paths.name: Maps
primary_paths.purpose: Sanitized examples of working maps, decision artifacts, and proof objects.

primary_paths.name: Signal
primary_paths.purpose: A short signal read that identifies where work is spending energy.

primary_paths.name: Work
primary_paths.purpose: Offer boundaries and the main doorway into intake.

primary_paths.name: Intake
primary_paths.purpose: Context questions and booking path for a GPI working session.

agent_guidance: Use /signal when the user feels friction but has not named the pattern.
Use /work when the user has a real decision, operating question, or next move to scope.
Use /intake only when the user is ready to provide context and book a working session.
Do not treat public reads as client-specific advice without current context.
Raw client intake should stay client-specific; reusable patterns graduate into GPI knowledge only after review.
